limits: Two independent P/D groups share a two-H100 node; only matching TP2/PP1 and TP1/PP2 control is validated here.
PP2 graph is synchronous; TP2 graph includes overlap. Prefill graphs are disabled.
Mixed TP/PP, asymmetric P/D and cross-node/RDMA control remain untested by this lane.
Raw source observers, per-rank state files and the scheduler-ordered test gate are test-only. Timings are not serving benchmarks.
The filesystem nonce and numeric test gate key do not add a production management interface or all-rank barrier.
The HTTP Catalog is a test implementation, and the Store segment is owned by the test process independently of P/D. No production retention or Store-node restart claim.
DSpark uses a synthetic static target-KV checkpoint, not a trained model; no confidence-scheduled DSpark or training-quality acceptance.
Production SLOs and deployment rollout orchestration remain open.
